mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.subtitle, p.feature_subtitle, p.brand, p.price, p.tag, p.category_code, c.name AS category_name, p.image_subject, p.poster_subject, p.is_feature, p.sales, p.list_order FROM product p JOIN product_category c ON c.code = p.category_code

sql.if: AND (p.name LIKE #{pattern} OR p.subtitle LIKE #{pattern} OR p.brand LIKE #{pattern} OR c.name LIKE #{pattern})

choose.when: ORDER BY p.sales DESC, p.id ASC
ORDER BY p.price ASC, p.id ASC
ORDER BY p.price DESC, p.id ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY p.is_feature DESC, p.list_order ASC, p.id ASC

mapper.select: ORDER BY c.list_order ASC, p.list_order ASC, p.id ASC
SELECT s.id, s.version, s.color, s.color_en, s.color_hex, s.price, s.stock, s.list_order FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY s.list_order ASC, s.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p JOIN product_category c ON c.code = p.category_code

SELECT c.code AS code, c.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM product p JOIN product_category c ON c.code = p.category_code
GROUP BY c.code, c.name, c.list_order ORDER BY c.list_order ASC
